description: M1.1 loader cases (IC01). Each finding's location is written as marker text: the expected line and column are those of the marker's first character in that file (or of its n-th occurrence, or of the end of the file), computed by the test independently of the parser. One assertion routine runs every case against its YAML and JSON file, which is the format-parity check. A value given as {"yaml": ..., "json": ...} differs by format; a plain value applies to both.

cases.name: duplicate key at the top level

message.yaml: The field "title" appears twice in the same mapping.
message.json: The field "title" appears twice in the same object.

fix.yaml: Keep one "title" and delete or rename the other.
fix.json: Keep one "title" and delete or rename the other.

message.yaml: The field "layout" appears twice in the same mapping.
message.json: The field "layout" appears twice in the same object.

fix.yaml: Keep one "layout" and delete or rename the other.
fix.json: Keep one "layout" and delete or rename the other.

cases.name: duplicate key written with an escape

findings.message: The field "title" appears twice in the same object.
findings.fix: Keep one "title" and delete or rename the other.

cases.note: Keys are compared after unescaping, so \u0074 is the same t.

message.yaml: The manifest must be a mapping of fields, one per line, such as schema: 1.
message.json: The manifest must be one JSON object of fields.

fix.yaml: Write each field as name: value at the start of a line.

message.yaml: The manifest must be a mapping of fields, one per line, such as schema: 1.
message.json: The manifest must be one JSON object of fields.

fix.yaml: Write each field as name: value at the start of a line.

cases.name: empty manifest

findings.message: The manifest is empty.
findings.fix: Start the manifest with schema: 1, template: and title:.

cases.note: An empty file has no token to point at, so the line is null rather than an invented line 1.

cases.name: schema missing

findings.message: The manifest has no schema field.
findings.fix: Add schema: 1 as the first field of the manifest.
findings.detail: Container location: the manifest that starts here has no schema.

cases.note: A missing field maps to its container: the root mapping, which in YAML starts at its first key.

findings.message: schema must be the whole number 1, not "1".
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

findings.message: schema: 0 is not a manifest version; this release reads schema 1.
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

findings.message: schema must be the whole number 1, not 1.5.
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

cases.name: schema newer than the tool

findings.message: The manifest's schema 2 is newer than this version of Papeleria, which reads schema 1.
findings.fix: Update Papeleria, or set schema: 1 if the file was written by hand.

cases.note: R17 only: the unknown field a newer format may carry is never reported as R09.

cases.name: schema 2.0 is the number 2, newer than the tool

findings.message: The manifest's schema 2 is newer than this version of Papeleria, which reads schema 1.
findings.fix: Update Papeleria, or set schema: 1 if the file was written by hand.

cases.note: Judged by value, as JSON Schema integer and Ajv judge it (D164(b)).

cases.name: schema 1e400 is past a double: not a manifest version

findings.message: schema must be the whole number 1, not Infinity.
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

cases.name: YAML: schema .inf is not a manifest version

findings.message: schema must be the whole number 1, not Infinity.
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

cases.name: YAML: schema .nan is not a manifest version

findings.message: schema must be the whole number 1, not NaN.
findings.fix: Set schema: 1.

findings.message: JSON has no NaN, Infinity or undefined.
findings.fix: Write a finite number, or null.

cases.name: nesting depth 33 is refused at the collection that crosses the limit

findings.message: The manifest nests more than 32 levels deep.

fix.yaml: Flatten the structure; the limit is 32 nested lists and mappings, counting the top level.
fix.json: Flatten the structure; the limit is 32 nested arrays and objects, counting the top level.

findings.message: This quoted value is never closed.
findings.fix: Close the value with the same quotation mark it opens with.
findings.detail: The parser reached line 5 still inside the quotes.

cases.name: YAML: a double-quoted value whose last quotation mark is escaped is never closed

findings.message: This quoted value is never closed.
findings.fix: Close the value with the same quotation mark it opens with.
findings.detail: The \" at the end of line 3 is an escaped quotation mark, part of the text, so it does not close the value.

cases.note: The parser cuts the value at the line end and its composer checks only the last character, so without this check the title would silently become Files live in C:\docs".

cases.name: YAML: a single-quoted value that ends in a doubled quotation mark is never closed

findings.message: This quoted value is never closed.
findings.fix: Close the value with the same quotation mark it opens with.
findings.detail: The '' at the end of line 3 is an escaped quotation mark, part of the text, so it does not close the value.

cases.note: '' is one quotation mark inside a single-quoted value; without this check the title would silently become Rosa'.

findings.message: The YAML cannot be read here: Tabs are not allowed as indentation
findings.fix: Indent with spaces, not tabs.

cases.name: YAML: unquoted colon inside a value

findings.message: The YAML cannot be read here: Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings
findings.fix: Check the indentation, and quote a value that contains a colon followed by a space.

findings.message: The YAML cannot be read here: Plain value cannot start with reserved character @
findings.fix: Quote a value that starts with @ or a backtick.

cases.name: YAML: a flow list closed at its parent's indentation is accepted

findings.message: The anchor &shared is not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Remove the anchor and write the value out in full where it is used.

findings.message: The alias *shared is not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Replace the alias with the value it stands for.

findings.message: Merge keys (<<) are not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Write the merged fields out in full in this mapping.

findings.message: The tag !upper is not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Remove the tag. Quote the value if it must stay text.

findings.message: The tag !!binary is not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Remove the tag. Quote the value if it must stay text.

findings.message: Custom tag handles are not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Remove the %TAG line and any tags that use it.

findings.message: The tag !e!title is not supported in a manifest.
findings.fix: Remove the tag. Quote the value if it must stay text.

cases.name: YAML: keys that are not text

findings.message: A mapping key must be text.
findings.fix: Write the field name as text, such as title:, and quote it if it looks like a number, true or null.

findings.message: A mapping key must be text.
findings.fix: Write the field name as text, such as title:, and quote it if it looks like a number, true or null.

findings.message: A mapping key must be text.
findings.fix: Write the field name as text, such as title:, and quote it if it looks like a number, true or null.

findings.message: A mapping key must be text.
findings.fix: Write the field name as text, such as title:, and quote it if it looks like a number, true or null.

findings.message: The manifest contains more than one YAML document.
findings.fix: Keep one document: remove this --- line and anything after it that is not part of the manifest.

cases.name: YAML: document end markers around the one document are accepted
cases.note: YAML 1.2 allows any number of ... lines before and after a document (l-yaml-stream); the parser gives each stray one an empty document of its own, which is not a second document.

cases.name: YAML: a second document after a document end marker

findings.message: The manifest contains more than one YAML document.
findings.fix: Keep one document: remove this ... line and anything after it that is not part of the manifest.

cases.note: With no --- line, the second document starts after the ... that ends the first, so that is the marker named.

findings.message: The manifest declares %YAML 1.1; only YAML 1.2 is accepted.
findings.fix: Remove the %YAML line, or change it to %YAML 1.2.

cases.name: JSON: trailing comma in an object

findings.message: JSON does not allow a comma before }.
findings.fix: Remove the trailing comma.

cases.name: JSON: trailing comma in an array

findings.message: JSON does not allow a comma before ].
findings.fix: Remove the trailing comma.

findings.message: JSON does not allow comments.
findings.fix: Remove the comment, or write the manifest as papeleria.yaml, which allows comments after #.

findings.message: JSON does not allow comments.
findings.fix: Remove the comment, or write the manifest as papeleria.yaml, which allows comments after #.

findings.message: JSON strings and keys use double quotes.
findings.fix: Replace the single quotes with double quotes.

findings.message: This is not a valid JSON number.
findings.fix: Remove leading zeros, and write decimals with a digit on both sides of the point.

findings.message: JSON has no NaN, Infinity or undefined.
findings.fix: Write a finite number, or null.

findings.message: A JSON number cannot start with +.
findings.fix: Remove the plus sign.

cases.name: JSON: string broken by a line end

findings.message: This string is not closed before the end of its line.
findings.fix: Close the string with a double quotation mark; write \n for a line break inside the text.

cases.name: JSON: raw tab inside a string

findings.message: A JSON string cannot contain a raw line break, tab or other control character.
findings.fix: Write \n for a line break and \t for a tab inside the quotes.

findings.message: The escape \q is not valid JSON.
findings.fix: Use one of \" \\ \/ \b \f \n \r \t or \u followed by four hexadecimal digits.

findings.message: Unexpected " where JSON expects a colon after the key.
findings.fix: Check for a missing comma, colon, quotation mark or bracket just before this position.

findings.message: Unexpected " where JSON expects a comma or }.
findings.fix: Check for a missing comma, colon, quotation mark or bracket just before this position.

findings.message: Text continues after the end of the JSON value.
findings.fix: Remove everything after the closing brace of the manifest.

cases.name: JSON: file ends inside an array

findings.message: The JSON ends before a value.
findings.fix: Complete the manifest; a bracket, brace or value is missing at the end.
